questions.question: How can I list the Lease objects that each kube-apiserver owns?
questions.notes: kube-system namespace, label selector apiserver.kubernetes.io/identity=kube-apiserver

questions.question: What command tells me whether a Linux node is using cgroup v1 or cgroup v2, and what output means v2?
questions.notes: stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup/ returns cgroup2fs for v2, tmpfs for v1

questions.question: Which finalizer does Kubernetes add to an object during foreground cascading deletion?
questions.notes: foregroundDeletion

questions.question: When you delete an owner object, does Kubernetes delete its dependents by default or leave them behind?
questions.notes: By default dependents are deleted; orphaning must be requested
questions.expected_substring: By default, Kubernetes deletes dependent objects

questions.question: How does a node add itself to a cluster without an administrator creating the Node object?
questions.notes: Self-registration of Nodes, kubelet started with registration options

questions.question: Should I still use SSH tunnels to protect traffic between the API server and the kubelet?
questions.notes: SSH tunnels are deprecated; Konnectivity is the replacement

questions.question: What happens when an API server receives a request for a resource version it does not itself serve during an upgrade?
questions.notes: Mixed version proxying forwards the request to a peer API server that can serve it
questions.expected_substring: attempts to send the request to a peer API server that can serve the requested API

questions.question: Which component configures routes in the cloud so containers on different nodes can reach each other?
questions.notes: The route controller inside the cloud controller manager
questions.expected_substring: The route controller is responsible for configuring routes

questions.question: What is a control loop and how does it move the cluster toward the desired state?
questions.notes: Controllers watch current state and act to move it toward spec

questions.question: What delivery guarantee do container lifecycle hooks provide?
questions.notes: At least once, so a hook may be called more than once

questions.question: Is the PostStart hook guaranteed to run before the container entrypoint starts?
questions.notes: No. ENTRYPOINT and PostStart are triggered simultaneously, ordering is not guaranteed

questions.question: What is the default imagePullPolicy and when does the kubelet skip pulling an image?
questions.notes: IfNotPresent skips the pull when the image is already present locally
questions.expected_substring: the image is pulled only if it is not already present locally

questions.question: Which API group defines the RuntimeClass resource?
questions.notes: node.k8s.io

questions.question: What hostname does a container see when it calls gethostname?
questions.notes: The name of the Pod the container runs in
questions.expected_substring: the name of the Pod in which the Container is running

questions.question: What protocol does the kubelet use to talk to the container runtime, and which side is the client?
questions.notes: gRPC, with the kubelet acting as the client
questions.expected_substring: The kubelet acts as a client when connecting to the container runtime via gRPC

questions.question: How many endpoints does an EndpointSlice hold by default, and what is the highest I can configure?
questions.notes: 100 by default via maxEndpointsPerSlice, up to a maximum of 1000

questions.question: Which Service field makes traffic go only to endpoints on the same node as the caller?
questions.notes: spec.internalTrafficPolicy set to Local

questions.question: Which annotation turns on topology aware routing for a Service?
questions.notes: service.kubernetes.io/topology-mode set to Auto

questions.question: How many endpoints per zone should a Service have before zone based routing works well?
questions.notes: Three or more endpoints per zone

questions.question: What is the default ndots setting in a Pod's resolv.conf?
questions.notes: options ndots:5

questions.question: Are a pod's outbound connections restricted before any policy is applied to it?
questions.notes: No. A pod is non-isolated for egress by default, all outbound connections allowed

questions.question: How do I stop a Service from being assigned an IP address I want to keep free?
questions.notes: Reserving ClusterIPs and avoiding conflicts

questions.question: What has to be true of my cluster before I can give Pods both an IPv4 and an IPv6 address?
questions.notes: Dual-stack prerequisites

questions.question: Which networking API is designed around organizational roles rather than a single resource?
questions.notes: Gateway API, role-oriented design principle

questions.question: How many EBS volumes can be attached to a node running an M5 instance type?
questions.notes: 25 on M5, C5, R5, T3 and Z1D; 39 otherwise

questions.question: Which reclaim policy runs a basic scrub of the volume so it can be claimed again, and is it still recommended?
questions.notes: Recycle, which runs rm -rf on the volume and is deprecated in favour of dynamic provisioning

questions.question: How do I delay binding a volume until a Pod that needs it is actually scheduled?
questions.notes: volumeBindingMode set to WaitForFirstConsumer

questions.question: Which fields does a VolumeSnapshotClass contain?
questions.notes: driver, deletionPolicy and parameters

questions.question: What is the difference between a CSI ephemeral volume and a generic ephemeral volume?
questions.notes: CSI ephemeral volumes need a third-party CSI driver; generic ephemeral volumes can use any storage driver that supports dynamic provisioning

questions.question: How do I mount a secret, a configMap and downward API data into a Pod under one directory?
questions.notes: A projected volume maps several existing volume sources into the same directory
questions.expected_substring: maps several existing volume sources into the same directory

questions.question: Which PVC field can reference an arbitrary object as the source of the volume's data, rather than only a PVC or snapshot?
questions.notes: dataSourceRef, as opposed to dataSource

questions.question: Which resource lets an administrator describe mutable storage classes mapping to different quality-of-service levels?
questions.notes: VolumeAttributesClass, which contains driverName and parameters

questions.question: Which kubelet metric reports that a volume is in an abnormal condition?
questions.notes: kubelet_volume_stats_health_status_abnormal

questions.question: How does the scheduler avoid placing a Pod on a node whose storage backend has no room left?
questions.notes: CSIStorageCapacity objects, consumed by the scheduler when the driver publishes capacity

questions.question: How can a volume be created on demand when a user claims one, instead of an administrator provisioning it ahead of time?
questions.notes: Dynamic provisioning driven by a StorageClass
